rows.label: tlk70000054_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Everyone, have you already met the
king of Iira?

rows.label: tlk70000054_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I hear the king was once a military
officer who won many victories through
his exceptional leadership.

rows.label: tlk70000054_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Adel-sama's gift as leader
comes from his own ability,
and from his father too.

rows.label: tlk70000054_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Perhaps that's why many in the
resistance want Adel-sama to become
the next king of Iira.

rows.label: tlk70000054_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm pretty sure he doesn't share
those sentiments, though.
